purpose: Clean-directory rebuild of the Lean sources for v1.2.0
procedure: Same procedure as logs/clean-replay-v1.1.0-receipt.json: fresh directory, sources and configuration copied from the release tree, shared Lake package cache for Mathlib at the pinned revision, fresh .lake/build.

`/usr/bin/time -l lake build` (log: clean-replay-v1.2.0-build.log); audit files ICGGeneralAudit and ICGBridgeAudit (logs: clean-replay-v1.2.0-audit-*.log); `shasum -a 256` of sources and configuration (logs/lean-sources-sha256.txt, 38 files), checked against the release tree with `shasum -c` (38 of 38 OK).

`lake env leanchecker <Module>` for the six modules new in v1.2.0 (log: clean-replay-v1.2.0-leanchecker-new-modules.log); the other 26 modules are unchanged since v1.1.0 (same hashes) and passed leanchecker then (logs/clean-replay-v1.1.0-leanchecker.log).
notes: Written from the logs listed above; paths are logical names.
